title: Easier planning across your workspace
summary: Find courses, change settings, and review your work with fewer menus and less scrolling.
highlights: Course filters open in a full-width panel; grade plans expand when needed.
Completed tasks have search and ten-entry pages.
Search for a time zone and keep Save settings within reach.

title: Keep your deadlines in a subscribed calendar
summary: Create a private calendar subscription link for your active task deadlines.
highlights: Calendar apps can retrieve changes without another file import.
Replace or disable the subscription link from the Calendar page.
Refresh timing depends on your calendar app; this is a one-way feed.

title: Stay signed in on your own device
summary: Choose a thirty-day session when signing in, or set a longer inactivity limit in Settings.
highlights: Sign-in forms show useful errors and a loading state.
Logout and password changes still revoke account sessions.

title: A tutorial that stays with you
summary: The tutorial controls stay at the bottom while you explore the practice planner.
highlights: Collapse instructions without losing Show me or Next.
A shorter homepage introduces the planner and its developer.

title: Missing update history restored
summary: Restored the entries missing between September 19 and the latest release.
highlights: The complete technical history remains available separately.

title: Draft a larger set of assignments
summary: The optional AI drafter can suggest up to thirty main tasks in one draft.
highlights: Review and edit suggestions before saving.
Choose standalone tasks, projects with steps, or a mix.

title: Start with five minutes
summary: Start a short focus timer from Today and park distracting thoughts for later.
highlights: The timer does not complete tasks automatically.
Parked thoughts stay in your browser tab.
